howItWorks.description: Tell us about your vision. We'll discuss your needs, style preferences, and logistics.

howItWorks.title: Planning

howItWorks.title: Delivery
howItWorks.description: Professionally edited gallery delivered in your preferred format. Prints and albums available.

faq.question: What is your turnaround time for edited photos?
faq.answer: For portrait sessions, edited photos are delivered within 5 business days. Event galleries take 10–14 days. Rush delivery available upon request.

faq.question: Do you offer retouching and editing?
faq.answer: Yes, all sessions include professional retouching. Color grading, skin tone adjustment, and background enhancement are standard.

faq.question: Can I purchase prints or albums?
faq.answer: Absolutely. We offer high-quality prints, canvases, and luxury albums. Pricing available upon request.

faq.question: What's your cancellation policy?
faq.answer: Cancellations made 7+ days in advance receive a full refund. Within 7 days, a 50% refund is issued. No-shows forfeit the full fee.

faq.question: Do you offer package deals?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer discounts for multiple sessions and volume orders. Contact us for custom pricing.
